Thanks for trying v4. Fill in whatever you can; a sentence per section is plenty. The questions we most want answered are in [v4-preview/what-we-want-to-learn.md](https://github.com/peterkaminski-ai/pkai-starter-kit/blob/main/v4-preview/what-we-want-to-learn.md).

Please leave out anything private: no passwords or keys, and nothing from your own files.

## Your setup
- **Computer:** Mac or Windows, and which version (e.g. macOS 26, Windows 11)
- **Fresh machine?** A new computer or user account, or one you already use
- **Kit version:** from the kit's `VERSION.md` (e.g. 4.0.0-rc.3)
- **Desktop app version:** Claude menu → About Claude (Mac), or the app's Help/About (Windows)
- **Git before you started?** Yes / no / not sure

## How it went
- **Did you get to your agent's first hello?** Yes / no
- **Roughly how long did it take?**

## Where you got stuck or confused
What happened, roughly when, and what you expected instead. Screenshots welcome.

## Answers to any of the open questions
For example, what a button or setting was called and where you found it.
